ارتهنتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَهَنْتُنَّ (irtahantunna) /ir.ta.han.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اُرْتُهِنْتُنَّ (urtuhintunna) /ur.tu.hin.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
